question: What is the highest recorded temperature in Germany during the 2026 European heatwaves?
answer:
Based on the search results I found, the highest recorded temperature in Germany during the 2026 European heatwaves was **38.5 °C (101.3 °F) in Kitzingen on June 19, 2026**.

This occurred during the second, more severe heatwave that began on June 17, 2026. The search results indicate that temperatures in Germany exceeded 30°C at many weather stations during this period, and by June 27, 13 of the 16 German states had broken their all-time temperature records.

FINAL: 38.5 °C (101.3 °F) in Kitzingen on June 19, 2026
